name: MacKreel's Moonshine
summary: On the broken Thandol Span, Foggy MacKreel brews moonshine strong enough to fell a sentry. Brewmeister Bilger in Southshore takes a batch to settle Foggy's debt.

sections.title: A Potent Brew
sections.body: Foggy MacKreel brews his moonshine while stationed as a guard on the Thandol Span. The liquor has a fierce reputation, and even hardened dwarven sentries can be laid low after a night of drinking it. They wake with headaches like siege engines rolling overhead. Travelers value its warmth against the damp chill of Lordaeron and Khaz Modan.

sections.title: Payment to Southshore
sections.body: Foggy MacKreel owed an unsettled debt to Brewmeister Bilger, Southshore's tavern keeper and master brewer. He sent a batch of moonshine instead of coin to clear his tab. Bilger accepts the liquor in place of gold and adds MacKreel's potent brew to his stock for the chilly coastal days of the Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.answer: Foggy MacKreel, a dwarf sentry stationed on the broken Thandol Span between the Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands, distills the moonshine.

faq.q: Why is this moonshine being sent to Southshore?
faq.answer: Foggy MacKreel owed a debt to Brewmeister Bilger in Southshore. He agreed to settle it by sending Bilger a fresh batch of moonshine instead of coin.
MacKreel's Moonshine is exceptionally strong. Foggy admitted that he passed out while on duty after drinking it, then woke with a headache like siege engines rumbling over his skull.

faq.q: Why does the delivery need to be rushed?
faq.answer: Foggy drank heavily and slept through his watch. When he woke, only minutes remained before his debt deadline with Brewmeister Bilger.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know a good stiff drink when you smell one. Foggy's moonshine packs enough punch to knock a mountaineer flat.
As a cook, you know potent regional spirits like Foggy's rough moonshine are staple trade goods across frontier taverns.
